scope: Single private method CreateConsumerKindEndpointDefinition; retain every selected category and stable Kind.Order. Fourteen public NuGet Console cases; four strict compiled single-source mutants. No whole Core closure.

source_contract.cause: Old GroupBy/First retained only first category endpoint definitions. Handler registration loop already included all categories: missing saga callback and shared QoS/topology guard is the proven cause, not missing saga message dispatch.
source_contract.fix: Stable OrderBy on all selected registrations followed by existing DelegateEndpointDefinition/Combine. Zero-registration fallback and explicit global definition precedence remain unchanged; no public signature change.
source_contract.validation: All endpoint plans eagerly composed before ReceiveEndpoint/global callback. Combined definition rejects local QoS on shared ownership and topology disagreement; successful local callbacks execute Consumer before Saga, stable within category.
source_contract.compatibility: Existing same-category order, category owner arbitration, explicit global override, default and single typed bus generic overload routes retain behavior. Invalid mixed definitions now fail at configuration as intended; Saga and Abstractions packages unchanged.

public_oracle.route: Ordinary AddViciOneServiceBus/AddViciOneServiceBus<ISharedBus>, required conservative limits retained in typed generic lambda, AddConsumer and AddSaga().InMemoryRepository, normal UsingInMemory/ConfigureEndpoints, normal DI BuildServiceProvider/IBusInstance resolution, actual endpoint Send and PostConsume terminal observer.
public_oracle.positive_assertions: Actual message index/address and saga actual correlation business assertions, terminal/fault counts, single public materialization callback, exact local/global ordered definition callbacks; no reflection/IVT/source-project reference.
public_oracle.negative_assertions: Required ConfigurationException or exact EndpointQosConfigurationException with endpoint and owner detail, topology marker, zero global endpoint materialization callbacks. Mutants weaken those guards and cause exact NotNull failure.
public_oracle.cleanup: OwnedLifetime independently attempts bus stop, observer disposal, provider disposal and static Saga Probe/LogContext restoration after captured primary; sole failure uses EDI and dual failures remain ordered aggregate. Start ownership flag set before await. No guard exception can become an accepted assertion pass.
public_oracle.limits: No actual effective QoS16/21/4 introspection; no saga repository persistence/reload test, multiple typed buses or parallel Probe execution.
